key.name: today-panel
key.summary: Clock menu: Today (a card for this computer, world clocks, weather) in place of the month grid

key.name: show-events
key.summary: Clock menu: show GNOME's calendar events card (with or without Today)

key.name: animation-speed
key.summary: Animation duration multiplier (below 1 is faster, e.g. 0.8)

key.name: double-super-to-appgrid
key.summary: Pressing Super again while the overview is open shows the app grid (instead of closing it)

key.name: migrated-jp
key.summary: Just Perfection's start-in-overview was copied once (internal)

key.name: folder-colour
key.summary: Folder icons (Yaru): follow the accent colour, or one Yaru colour ('default' is Yaru's orange)

key.name: accent-follows-wallpaper
key.summary: When the wallpaper changes, pick the accent from the new one (only if the accent came from the old wallpaper)

key.name: now-playing-pill
key.summary: Beside the clock: what's playing (title and play state; click for previous, play/pause, next); it pops out when something starts playing and goes back a few seconds after it stops

key.name: quick-settings-corner
key.summary: Push the pointer into the top-right corner to open quick settings, like the top-left corner opens the overview

key.name: clock-menu-quiet
key.summary: Clock menu: Do Not Disturb and Focus switches under the date (the quick-settings tiles stay either way)

key.name: quick-settings-style
key.summary: Quick settings: 'ostrich' adds the power-mode row on three-mode machines and tiles for your recent Bluetooth devices; 'stock' leaves GNOME's own tiles as they are (the clearer lit-tile text stays either way)

key.name: hover-open-menus
key.summary: Rest the pointer on the clock or the now-playing orb to open its menu, as on drawer icons; it closes when the pointer leaves

key.name: bluetooth-recent
key.summary: Addresses of the Bluetooth devices last seen connected, newest first: the quick-settings device tiles show these first

key.name: hover-open-delay-ms
key.summary: How long the pointer rests on the clock or the now-playing orb before its menu opens, in milliseconds

key.name: now-playing-play-pause
key.summary: Shortcut: play or pause what the now-playing pill shows (unset by default)

key.name: hidden-panel-items
key.summary: Top-bar items to hide, by their status-area name (e.g. 'a11y', 'keyboard', 'screenRecording')
